content: Gamag ya̱kids, tasiyas tanuwgwes idaluns ikawes siwotet peinads gamag ya̱kids, mamagina dasiwa̱youbs ikawes, isekes Yowbad, waseg bitaluns; peinan adsinaps kalbaleb.
Tasiyas tanuwgwes idaluns bikagma̱nums wasigeis tasiyas toubols sisiyas tasiyas talasisulins ked, peinan tanuwgwes idaluns igwey asisinap tatineis.
E, peinan tougweys, tanuwgwes lun tasiyas, o asisinap kalbaleb, kadiloka bilineiluns waseg Yowbad; o bilineiluns waseg Yowbad pines babaw gamag.
Tanuwagan lun nag tonena bikow nawotet towen, nag. Peinan Yowbad bidow silma̱nin wotet towen. Ma̱wan kweiboug Elon nidow.
Kelis-vak nag tatonen iyamwen va̱gan bimlavag tanuwagan lun, nag. Yowbad gog bo isek nawotet towen. Anilivan mamagina:

content.text: “Bukusigeg tanuwagan lun ya̱koum, ma̱wan tanuwagan lun towen Melkisidek.”

content: Misiya̱mun Yeisuw imlavag gimgeilin ven watinow, mo ininitoug igilagel Yowbad waseg, iwkuwak ivva̱lam. Sivinan kid Yowbad bikatinob kanig waseg. Yowbad mo iligen, peinan Natun bo igoul.
Towen Yowbad Natun, tage gamag iyagages, ikanow aygan Taman, mo ikakin ked towen keikay.
E, youd babaw waseg ikanaway Taman aygan, mo imlavag takatinabweids ya̱kids. Kukin bitakanawes aygan towen bo bitasesus bwein, tasigagas.
Peinan Yowbad bo isek nawotet tanuwagan lun, ma̱wan Melkisedek kweiboug.
Sinap towen liva̱nen avakaein badibakeimiy, tage keikay, peinan ikawegweis woumiy.

Tut towen waseg kadiloka bukumtakavates gamag mwasanin. Nag gog. Singay tatagouwaw yakamiy. Kadiloka bakakamtilakeimiy vayuwein mo bukukwakins silawun Yowbad anilivan. Igawa kumwamoums sus. Ta-ma̱wan kan bukukwams.
Yakamiy kusasus ma̱wan tasiyas a̱pwaw. Nag kukwakins liva̱nen sinap didumwal.
Igaw bukuwkuva̱kaeins mo bukukwams kan, mamagina amisinap bimatuw, ninoumiy biwotet, mo bukukwakins aveiyag bwein, aveiyag kalbaleb.
